sprint_goal_verdict.note: All 24 planned units, 49 points, delivered on independent APPROVEs (four after one repair round each). Lanes land and die cleanly (BG1336, BG1337, BG1339, BG1344, BG1261, BG1262) and verifiers no longer read green wrongly or leak (BG1005, BG1009, BG0991, BG1112, BG1190, BG1228). Cost is priced over the whole window and for long Grok prompts (BG1279, BG1305, BG1330, BG1331), but every lane this run was multi-unit and lane return cannot split one builder's total, so per-unit cost stays unpriced (BG1397). BG1420, added when the push gate found five red tests, fixed them but was carried as BG1425 after its repair's round-2 review.
